title: How it was solved: a tab beside the code, not always shown
description: The compiler's explanation (tempo/key/tuning found, warp and transposition per chord, and why) sat in the score's side panel on every page. Move it to a second tab of the code editor (Code | How it was solved), hidden until asked for. Problems and warnings stay in the side panel.
